levels.test: Target family recognized from question; log memory and source exposure. This level alone is not reconstruction.
Question answered by explicit model/design and central findings generated by current proof/analysis artifacts.
Entire conclusion-carrying evidence/model scope in the published article accounted for, including unsupported or inaccessible blocks as failures of full recovery.
All applicable frozen-harness gates actually pass, full manuscript and reviewed PDF retained, independent review completed and clean-run evidence present.

rules: Do not combine different estimands or samples merely because the displayed number is similar.
Compare a worker balanced-panel estimate to the published balanced-panel target; keep all-available and adjusted specifications separate.
A source constraint imposed by the benchmark is an experimental restriction, not a discovered general harness defect.
Additional inputs missing from the publicly acquired archive are reported as data limitations, not automatic software bugs.
A proof with correct discounted special case does not recover all waiting-cost preferences in the original.
Within-budget incompleteness is not proof that a longer autonomous run could never succeed.
Independent review may trigger internal revisions, but evaluator answers and original numbers are never given to workers.
The two cases cannot estimate an overall journal-level success probability.
